snapshots.note: Initial policy-based classifier: criteria shape with gendered slurs and immigrant dehumanization. Accuracy 0.30 on 10-record check set (3/10 correct). Too many FP on casual slur use; missed rapefugee slur. Will refine instructions.

Final policy-refined classifier using criteria shape. Reduced false positives on casual slur use vs v1, predicts 596 hate (vs 654 in v1, 548 in v3). Check accuracy 0.30 (3/10). Still struggles with rapefugee/weak migration rhetoric FN and policy-complaint FP. ~30% edge case noise expected per oracle.
